evidence.quote: The text provides publication dates (Received: 4 January 2021 / Accepted: 15 March 2021 / Published online: 31 March 2021) but does not state the calendar year the first/baseline wave of data was collected.

[/page/0/Text/7] Participants included 665 youth recruited in 3rd, 6th, and 9th grade cohorts (55.0% female; age 9–16 at baseline) who provided self-report ratings of positive and negative affect every 18 months for a period of three years in an accelerated longitudinal cohort design.
